newsitem.title: SIERRA LEONE: Five crash deaths mar Sierra Leone marathon.
newsitem.headline: Five crash deaths mar Sierra Leone marathon.

text.p: Five local Red Cross workers died and 15 were seriously wounded when a van carrying them rammed into a tree during an annual marathon race in Sierra Leone, hospital officials said on Monday.

Four of the workers, who were assisting fatigued runners, died on the spot on Sunday after the driver lost control of the vehicle as he descended a steep mountain road and crashed near State House in Freetown.
The fifth died in hospital on Monday and some of the 15 injured were still in critical condition, hospital staff said.

About 500 people, mostly Sierra Leoneans but including some Ghanaians, Liberians, Gambians and resident Lebanese, took part in the annual Guiness mountain marathon. The winner this year was Gambian Momodu Jalloh.
The race was intended to support a drive to stop farmers cutting trees on mountain slopes.
